title: Tesseract: retro-computer vaporwave scene that zooms out into its own editor
summary: A vaporwave still-life (beige 80s PC on an orange perspective-grid floor under a cyan-to-pink sky) where the headline 'You can now build / your own editor with / Tesseract' bounces in letter by letter. The camera then pulls back to reveal the scene is a canvas inside a custom keyframe editor (timeline, property panel, colour wheel being built live from prompts), then pulls back again so the editor is on the CRT of another retro PC, ending on a Tesseract logo card on the CRT. Recursive, playful, self-referential.
fit_reason: The recursive zoom-out 'the video is inside the product' reveal is a strong idea for a white-label portal (your brand inside their portal), though the vaporwave styling is off-brand.

palette.mood: retro vaporwave pastels (cyan sky, orange grid, mint) framed by a dark charcoal editor UI

typography.display: bold rounded geometric sans (Futura/ITC Avant Garde Bold-like) lowercase-ish headline; 'Tesseract' in heavy italic display with perspective (lying on the floor)
typography.size_behaviour: headline split into two corner blocks (top-left and right) ~6% height; product name huge in perspective at bottom
typography.notes: UI panels use tiny mono type; 'Made with Tesseract' mono watermark bottom-right.

text_animation: per-letter bounce-in: each letter drops from below with overshoot and slight scale, ~40 ms stagger, letters start small/low and settle on the baseline
brand word slides up in 3D perspective onto the floor letter by letter
motion: camera pull-back reveal (scene -> editor UI -> CRT on desk)
colour wheel UI builds and recolours live
graphic_elements: dark editor UI (timeline, property list, colour wheel)
ui_treatment: rebuilt dark editor UI wrapped around the scene; the scene becomes the editor's canvas

pacing.hold_time_s: one continuous shot, 3-6 s per zoom level

signature_moves: per-letter bounce headline split into opposite corners
zoom-out reveal: the ad is a canvas inside the product's own UI
recursion onto a CRT screen for the logo end card

best_segments.what: headline letters bounce in around the retro PC, brand word lands in perspective
pull back to reveal the editor UI around the scene, keyframes and prompt box

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion: hero still (AI image) as canvas; per-letter spans with y/scale spring stagger; wrap in rebuilt editor UI div and animate scale 1 -> 0.5; then place that whole composition onto a CRT image via CSS transform. Swap retro PC for a SaaSSuite portal screenshot.
recreate.prompt: Vaporwave still-life with a retro PC, headline letters bouncing in one by one, then the camera pulls back to reveal the scene is a canvas inside a dark editor UI, then pulls back again onto a CRT monitor showing the logo.
